identificationModule.briefTitle: Low Dose Epcoritamab Plus GemOx in R/R DLBCL
identificationModule.officialTitle: Low Dose Epcoritamab Plus Gemcitabine/Oxaliplatin in Treatment of Transplant Eligible Patients With Relapsed/Refractory Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma

leadSponsor.name: Hospital Universitario Dr. Jose E. Gonzalez

descriptionModule.briefSummary: In this study, researchers are looking to determine whether Gemcitabine/Oxaliplatin plus a lower dose of Epcoritamab (12 mg) works to treat subjects with relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, who are candidates to autologous stem cell transplantation.

conditions: Relapsed/Refractory Diffuse Large B Cell Lymphoma
keywords: relapsed/refractory diffuse large B cell lymphoma

armGroups.label: Epcoritamab + GemOx
armGroups.description: Subjects will receive Gemcitabine/Oxaliplatin at usual doses as well as Epcoritamab with 2 step up doses followed by 12 mg weekly for 3 cycles.

interventions.name: Epcoritamab
interventions.description: Subjects will receive 2 step up doses of Epcoritamab (0.16 mg and 0.8 mg) followed by 12 mg weekly, for a total of three 21-day cycles (8 applications)

interventions.name: Gemcitabine (1000 mg/m2)
interventions.description: Subjects will receive gemcitabine 1000 mg/m2 on days 1 and 15 of the three 21-day cycles.

interventions.name: Oxaliplatin
interventions.description: Subjects will receive oxaliplatin 100 mg/m2 on day 1 of three 21-day cycles.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Determine ORR and CR after GemOx plus low-dose Epcoritamab
primaryOutcomes.description: Determine ORR and CR after 3 cycles of GemOx plus low-dose Epcoritamab based on PET-CT
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From enrollment to the end of treatment at 14 weeks

secondaryOutcomes.description: Determine the number of subjects that complete the first cycle without need for hospitalization
Describe the number of subjects who develop grade 2-4 cytokine release syndrome during the first cycle of treatment

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Describe immune effector cell- associated neurotoxicity syndrome incidence
secondaryOutcomes.description: Describe the number of subjects that develop immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome
Describe the number of subjects that develop any adverse events

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Determine number of patients that follow through with transplant
secondaryOutcomes.description: Determine the number of patients that go through with stem cell transplant after finishing 3 cycles of Epcoritamab + GemOx
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From day one up through study completion, an average of 1 year
From week 18 through study completion, an average of 1 year

secondaryOutcomes.description: Report the subjects´ progression free survival
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From week 18 up to six and twelve months

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subjects with relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma who have received at least 1 previous line of treatment and that are candidates to autologous stem cell transplant
* ECOG 0-2
* Women of reproductive age who agree on getting a contraceptive method
* Subjects who fulfill Lugano´s criteria for disease activity
* Subjects who voluntarily accept to participate in this study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Active bacterial, viral or fungal infection
* Subjects who have already received an autologous o allogeneic stem cell transplantation
* Subjects with other active neoplasias
* Subjects with end-stage failure
